prompt: Flat 2D vector illustration brought to life, like a gentle picture-book animation. Locked-off camera: no zoom, no pan, no camera shake. A small capybara mascot with a yuzu fruit on its head peeks over the top edge of a tall stack of paper to-do lists, both front paws resting on the edge. It blinks once and glances to its right, then one paw nudges a tiny orange kettle out from behind its head and slides it along the top edge of the paper until it stops beside the capybara. One clear action only. The paper stack, its rows, the sticky notes, the pencil lying on top and the background stay completely still. Keep the exact flat colours, shapes and proportions of the character and the kettle from the first frame: no outlines, no texture, no shading changes, no new objects, no text or letters, no redesign.
